text:
dana: Proposing we cut RC-8521 into the 01:00 UTC change window. Need owners: sheriff, deploy lead, oncall rollback exec. Also confirm artifact pin and KV warm.
prod-deploy-bot: RC-8521 created from `release/edge@e9b7c1`. Artifacts pinned: `model-router:8521` (sha: bbccddeeff11). Bake-ready.
jen: I can sheriff 00:45-01:30 UTC.
omar: There's an outstanding hotfix PR (hotfix/edge-flag) that touches the routing feature flag. Owner says they'll hold merge until 02:00 UTC if we need it.
lia_oncall: If we flip the new routing, I want an easy rollback. Suggested rollback steps:
```
# revert image -> known-good
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/model-router model-router=redwood/model-router:8509
# flip feature flag back
POST https://config.internal/flags {"edge_routing":"off"} (auth via KMS token)
```
rick_release: Please run a deploybot preflight: `deploybot preflight --rc=8521 --kv-warm` and attach smoke logs. We should also pin the release notes in the changelog.
prod-deploy-bot: Preflight OK: KV warm passed (10/10 keys primed), smoke tests 3/3 ok (routing sanity). Scheduling promo at 01:00 UTC: canary 2% for 5m, 25% for 10m, then 100%. Auto-fallback to previous image if error rate >4%.
dana: Final roles: Jen = sheriff, Rick = deploy lead, Lia = rollback exec, Omar = migration hold. Any objections?
jen: No objections. I'll monitor dashboards and health checks.
lia_oncall: I'll be ready to execute rollback if SLOs break. Add the rollback command in the runbook and pin it.
prod-deploy-bot: Promo scheduled: RC-8521 -> prod at 01:00 UTC. All checks green.
dana: Great — see you at 00:55 for go/no-go. :eyes:
